svg.text: esp32esso: Oster Xpert electronics box wiring (ESP32-WROOM build, top view)
Layout follows electronics-box.scad (mains along the top wall, sensors on the right); not to scale
heater, pump, brew valve, relief valve
left + right load cells (4 wires each)
buck OUT+, ESP VIN, 2-SSR DC+, pressure +5V
buck OUT-, ESP GND, 2-SSR DC-, dimmer GND
ESP 3V3, MAX6675 x2, HX711 x2, dimmer VCC
Each signal wire has its own colour, labelled at both ends.
Dot = joined. A gap where wires cross = not joined.
Power and ground are shown as tags; every tag of the
same name lands on that rail post.
Set the buck to 5.0 V before the ESP32 is connected.
D18 (SCK) and D19 (SO) feed both MAX6675s; D22 (SCK)
feeds both HX711s: two wires in one terminal.
Valve, pump and heater neutrals stay outside the box.
